---
title: "Video Identity"
description: "Pass an uploaded video through a Gradio app without changing it."
---

This coding playground demonstrates browser video input and playable video output. Click **Run**, choose a video from your device, and submit it. The example adds no remote upload operation.

```{python}
import gradio as gr

def video_identity(video):
    return video


demo = gr.Interface(
    video_identity,
    gr.Video(),
    "playable_video",
    flagging_mode="never",
)

demo.launch()
```
